intro: With modern Parsons-inspired lines and a clever glass top that conceals display storage, our Bezel is as practical as it is striking—a true centrepiece for your dining room.

features.title: Glass top with a twist
features.text: A spray-painted 10 mm toughened glass top adds visual lightness and durability—easy to clean and beautiful to look at.

features.title: Smart display below
features.text: The see-through top reveals a recessed storage niche—perfect for showcasing décor or organizing essentials without clutter.

features.title: Sleek and symmetrical
features.text: Clean lines and a straight square metal tube frame ensure this piece fits right into minimalist or bold design schemes.

features.title: Safety meets style
features.text: Tempered glass with soft corners offers lasting durability while ensuring safe use in everyday, high-traffic settings.

features.title: Fits in beautifully
features.text: With its clean lines and compact footprint, Bezel adapts effortlessly to large dining rooms or smaller nooks—making a stylish statement in any space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
